parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: separate correctly, ∫(1 + y)e^(−3y)dy = ∫1/(1 + cos 2θ)dθ; allow 1/e^(3y) and missing integral signs. M1: integrate by parts to p(1 + y)e^(−3y) + ∫q e^(−3y)dy; allow unless the formula clearly has a plus sign. A1: obtain −(1/3)(1 + y)e^(−3y) + ∫(1/3)e^(−3y)dy, unsimplified allowed. A1: obtain −(1/3)(1 + y)e^(−3y) − (1/9)e^(−3y) + A; condone no constant. B1: use the correct double-angle formula to obtain ∫1/(2cos²θ)dθ. B1: obtain (1/2)tan θ + B; condone no constant. M1*: use y = 0, θ = π/4 to evaluate a constant in an expression containing only αye^(−3y), βe^(−3y) and γtan θ; must have integrated the left side twice, giving C = 17/18 in the scheme's arrangement. DM1: use y = 1 in the integrated equation; must have integrated the left side. A1: tan θ = 17/9 − (14/9)e^(−3), or exact equivalent; exact ISW. Allow θ = tan⁻¹(17/9 − (14/9)e^(−3)); if x is used instead of θ, withhold the final A1. [Total: 9]
